attack-and-damage.notes: Production combat uses the isolated kernel for dodge half damage, critical, forced critical, additive critical damage, effect ratio, typed resistance, boss increase, home damage, floor, minimum damage, attack-speed-scaled basic behavior delay, and the original live-caster versus dead-projectile attack snapshot boundary. H11 heal shields are additive and consume incoming damage before HP, with exact exhaustion leaving HP unchanged; no shield cap is recovered. H04 periodic healing follows the shipped generic heal formula rather than the card's max-HP wording: every one-second tick restores floor(attack * 200/10000) or floor(attack * 500/10000), plus HEAL_INC when present, then clamps to max HP. RG_H04_abl03 applies DMG_RES 3000 during each two-second shield-wall window; star 10 first dispatches floor(resistance-adjusted pre-floor incoming damage * 3000/10000) to the live attacker, then resolves the original hit through victim shield and HP, while CounterAttack status cannot recurse. RG_H04_abl04_eff01 runs before dodge, critical and ordinary damage on H04/H09 basic attacks; a successful inclusive 3000/10000 roll deals the recovered 999999 kill value to non-boss monsters through the common shield/damage route and consumes no later damage RNG, while bosses and non-basic actions skip its RNG entirely. Dodge now short-circuits the critical RNG read, forced-critical buffs do the same after a non-dodge, and attribute-based CRI_RATE 10000 still consumes its normal critical roll. H0905 follows the recovered BounceBullet route: the initial 35% projectile can make at most two further speed-400 bounces to the nearest unvisited enemy strictly inside 300 pixels, sharing one visited-target map. H13/H09 popcorn replacements preserve the same routing and compound the resolved live/snapshot attack by 1.1 once per follow-up bounce; the initial hit remains unchanged. TZ_1303's configured radius-50 final explosion is unreachable in shipped version 18 because child BounceBullet initialization checks last_missile before copying the parent bounce counter. Each H0905 segment renders the recovered H24_S1 projectile and creates the recovered three-frame H24_S1_LOWER impact plus bullet_zhanche audio; frame geometry is confirmed, while the current 30 FPS playback remains inferred pending matched video. RG_ALL_abl08_eff01 reads through the shared monster attribute layer for ordinary, elite and boss units. RG_H01_abl02 counts completed basic attacks, preserves an armed critical across dodge, consumes it only on an actual critical, and applies the star-10 heal at the recovered trigger point. RG_H01_abl03_eff01 receives only the single resolved final killer from MonsterUnit.onDie, not an assist list; every qualifying H01/H07 kill adds 200 ATK_INC, and the shared damage multiplier is max(0, 1 + (ATK_INC - ATK_DEC) / 10000), capped by the passive at 30 stacks. RG_H12_abl02 adds CRI_RATE 10000 at H12 star 2; RG_H12_abl03 adds CRI_DMG 5000 at star 7, raising an actual critical from 15000 to 20000 without granting chance by itself.
